notes: Slayer as host rules: game modes (Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch and modes other Add-Ons add, such as Capture the Flag), lives, points and time to win, rounds that end with the winner announced and reset after the time between rounds, the pre-round countdown with its voice and buzzer and players frozen in place, and teams that sort, balance and spawn on their own team spawns, with friendly fire off by default and team chat. Capture points (the 8x8 and 16x16 Capture Point bricks) fill a bar for a team standing on them, ease back when they leave, and turn to the capturing team's colour, with points for the capture and the onCPCapture, onCPCapture(TeamN) and onCPReset brick events. Players out of lives spectate five seconds after their last death: orbiting the living players and the capture points (fire and jet step through them), a free camera, or the auto camera gliding past each player at a wide angle, with jump or the light key changing the mode and Team-Only DeadCam, Enable Auto-Camera Mode and Spectate Capture Points in the settings. The fly-through camera works too: /createFlyCam, /setKnot, /setJump, /testFlyCam and /deleteFlyCam lay and try a path that flies every member before the round (Play At Beginning of Round, Countdown During Fly-Thru, Rounds Between Fly-Thrus). Its settings are in the Mini-Game window's Add-On Settings, beside the vanilla mini-game settings Slayer also edited; /teams and /slayer work as in Slayer. Not ported yet: uniforms, team loadouts, player types and scale, team respawn times, friendly-fire penalties, team swaps, the end of round report, bots, locking capture points (the setTeamControlLocked output), the StartFlyThrough event output, and keeping a fly-through path with saved mini-game settings (.pathcam).
